evidence_policy: primary paper, publisher or official proceedings pages; preprints are explicitly labelled
selection_policy: representative claim-preemption audit: include systems that directly occupy at least one dimension of the five-part ChemWorld intersection or would falsify a proposed novelty sentence; this is not an exhaustive AI-for-science bibliography
positioning: controlled experimental science of experimenting agents, grounded in executable chemistry
absolute_claims_rejected: first hidden-law or active mechanism-discovery benchmark
first process-level evaluation of scientific agents
first free-form exploration of an initially unknown physical system
first agent to learn reusable skills through active experimentation
first long-horizon or end-to-end autonomous scientific discovery trajectory
most complete or unlimited chemical world
replacement for robotic or physical autonomous laboratories

works.title: Autonomous chemical research with large language models
works.strongest_capability: LLM planning, documentation and code tools connected to liquid handling and cloud-laboratory execution
works.chemworld_boundary: ChemWorld offers cloned physical identities and controlled trajectory experiments but no real-hardware evidence

works.title: Augmenting large language models with chemistry tools
works.strongest_capability: eighteen chemistry tools, expert evaluation and physical synthesis across diverse chemistry tasks
works.chemworld_boundary: ChemWorld studies evidence-to-action stability under paired interventions rather than tool breadth

works.title: An autonomous laboratory for the accelerated synthesis of inorganic materials
works.strongest_capability: autonomous solid-state synthesis and characterization in a physical laboratory
works.chemworld_boundary: physical validity is stronger; counterfactual cloning and high-replication behavioral intervention are not its primary aim

works.title: Agentic LLM Reasoning in a Self-Driving Laboratory for Air-Sensitive Lithium Halide Spinel Conductors
works.strongest_capability: a 352-sample air-sensitive solid-state campaign with abductive and inductive proposal strategies analyzed over real experimental evidence
works.chemworld_boundary: preempts observation of distinct experimental strategies as a novelty; ChemWorld adds paired prior intervention and fresh-trajectory replication in fixed physical identities

works.title: ORGANA: A robotic assistant for automated chemistry experimentation and characterization
works.strongest_capability: natural-language goal interpretation, visual-feedback planning, parallel scheduling and real execution across four chemistry experiment families including a nineteen-step electrochemistry workflow
works.chemworld_boundary: stronger long-horizon perception and robotic execution; ChemWorld studies repeatability under controlled information and identity interventions

works.title: A Multiagent-Driven Robotic AI Chemist Enabling Autonomous Chemical Research On Demand
works.strongest_capability: hierarchical agents connected to literature, protocol, model and automated-laboratory resources across six task types plus transfer to a seventh robotic chemistry setting
works.chemworld_boundary: stronger multi-task real-lab orchestration and transfer; ChemWorld contributes cloned-world experimental designs rather than broader orchestration

works.title: Stress-testing large language model agents in a robotic chemistry laboratory
works.strongest_capability: 4,608 physical-workflow trials over 45 workstations measuring executability and feedback-driven replanning
works.chemworld_boundary: preempts scientific-agency-measurement as an absolute novelty; ChemWorld adds cloned worlds, prior intervention and exact replay

works.title: AutoLabs: cognitive multi-agent systems with self-correction for autonomous chemical experimentation
works.strongest_capability: five benchmark experiments and twenty agent configurations for hardware-ready liquid-handler protocol generation, including systematic reasoning and self-correction ablations
works.chemworld_boundary: stronger protocol-correctness evaluation; ChemWorld evaluates autonomous evidence-generating choices in an unknown stateful process

works.title: Verification and execution of the scientific literature via chemputation augmented by large language models
works.strongest_capability: literature extraction, XDL translation, hardware-constrained simulation and physical verification of six syntheses on two robotic platforms, supported by long-term procedure memory
works.chemworld_boundary: stronger literature reproducibility and physical execution; its object is faithful protocol translation rather than autonomous evidence-generating choice under cloned-world intervention

works.title: PRISM: protocol refinement through intelligent simulation modeling
works.strongest_capability: multi-agent protocol generation and critique, NVIDIA Omniverse digital-twin validation and coordinated execution across off-the-shelf robotic instruments
works.chemworld_boundary: stronger hardware-constrained protocol and multi-instrument execution evidence; ChemWorld studies agent-selected experiments and behavioral repeatability rather than protocol compilation

works.title: A flexible and affordable self-driving laboratory for automated reaction optimization
works.strongest_capability: approximately US$5,000 modular open hardware with Python control, Bayesian optimization and six real reaction case studies spanning single-objective, multi-objective and transfer workflows
works.chemworld_boundary: stronger real-chemistry, accessibility and scale-up evidence; ChemWorld targets identity-controlled behavioral intervention rather than physical reaction optimization

works.title: Accelerating scientific discovery with Co-Scientist
works.strongest_capability: multi-agent hypothesis generation and refinement with test-time-compute scaling, expert steering and wet-laboratory validation across three biomedical applications
works.chemworld_boundary: stronger literature synthesis, hypothesis novelty and biomedical validation; physical experiments remain expert-in-the-loop rather than primitive agent-controlled and identity-cloned

works.title: A multi-agent system for automating scientific discovery
works.strongest_capability: continuous literature-driven hypothesis generation and autonomous analysis of newly produced biological data, yielding experimentally confirmed therapeutic candidates
works.chemworld_boundary: stronger biomedical novelty and data analysis; scientists execute human-authored protocols, whereas ChemWorld exposes the full sample lifecycle to the agent under controlled replication

works.title: Operating advanced scientific instruments with AI agents that learn on the job
works.strongest_capability: multi-agent orchestration of an X-ray nanoprobe and a robotic materials station with multimodal input and persistent human-guidance memory
works.chemworld_boundary: stronger real-instrument and human-teaching evidence; its evaluation does not randomize prior information within cloned physical worlds

works.title: An agentic artificially intelligent X-ray scientist
works.strongest_capability: observation-conditioned stepwise command selection in a virtual six-circle diffractometer followed by deployment of the workflow on a real synchrotron beamline
works.chemworld_boundary: preempts autonomous stepwise instrument operation as a novelty; ChemWorld adds campaign resources, paired prior interventions and within-world fresh-trajectory phenotyping

works.title: ChemGymRL: A customizable interactive framework for reinforcement learning for digital chemistry
works.strongest_capability: fine-grained reinforcement-learning actions across interconnected virtual chemistry benches
works.chemworld_boundary: preempts first-operable-virtual-chemistry-lab claims; ChemWorld adds controlled prior interventions, resource provenance and trajectory replication

works.title: PC-Gym: Benchmark Environments For Process Control Problems
works.strongest_capability: nonlinear chemical-process control with disturbances, constraints and NMPC comparisons
works.chemworld_boundary: ChemWorld does not claim process-control novelty and instead evaluates evidence-generating experimental behavior

works.title: MADE: Benchmark Environments for Closed-Loop Materials Discovery
works.strongest_capability: modular budget-constrained end-to-end materials-discovery pipelines with formation-energy oracle feedback and systematic scaling comparisons across ternary, quaternary and quinary systems
works.chemworld_boundary: preempts budgeted closed-loop materials-environment claims; ChemWorld uses multi-operation experiment lifecycles and controlled interventions on agent information and physical identity

works.title: DiscoveryWorld: A Virtual Environment for Developing and Evaluating Automated Scientific Discovery Agents
works.strongest_capability: multimodal long-horizon hypothesis, experiment, analysis and explanation tasks
works.chemworld_boundary: preempts first-complete-discovery-cycle claims; ChemWorld contributes chemistry-native continuous state, ledgers and exact physical replay

works.title: BoxingGym: Benchmarking Progress in Automated Experimental Design and Model Discovery
works.strongest_capability: generative probabilistic environments with expected-information-gain and model-discovery evaluation
works.chemworld_boundary: ChemWorld adds physical experiment construction and lifecycle consequences rather than query-only experimental design

works.title: Measuring Scientific Capabilities of Language Models with a Systems Biology Dry Lab
works.strongest_capability: iterative experimentation over 350 systems-biology models
works.chemworld_boundary: greater dynamic-system scale; ChemWorld adds chemistry operations, instruments and resource-coupled lifecycles

works.title: Agentic Exploration of Physics Models
works.strongest_capability: free-form numerical experiment selection and analysis in initially unknown mechanical, wave and quantum systems, including equation-of-motion and Hamiltonian recovery without task-specific blueprints
works.chemworld_boundary: preempts open-ended unknown-system exploration and law recovery; ChemWorld adds chemistry-native experiment lifecycles, physical resource receipts and paired information interventions

works.title: Self-Evolving Scientific Agent Discovers Generalizable Physically-Reasoned Fluid Control
works.strongest_capability: multimodal diagnosis and iterative code refinement in a nonlinear fluid-structure simulation, yielding an interpretable controller that generalizes to unseen targets
works.chemworld_boundary: preempts a generic evidence-to-interpretable-control claim; ChemWorld adds chemical sample lifecycles, paired prior interventions and replicated trajectory phenotypes

works.title: NewtonBench: Benchmarking Generalizable Scientific Law Discovery in LLM Agents
works.strongest_capability: 324 counterfactual-law tasks across twelve physics domains
works.chemworld_boundary: stronger law-discovery scale; ChemWorld's first paper does not use world-law diversity as its central result

works.title: DiscoverPhysics: Benchmarking LLMs for Out-of-the-Box Scientific Thinking
works.strongest_capability: active experiments in 22 non-canonical N-body worlds with separate predictive and explanatory scores
works.chemworld_boundary: preempts non-canonical-world and prediction-explanation-dissociation novelty; ChemWorld grounds behavior in stateful chemical operations

works.title: LLM-AutoSciLab: Closed-Loop Scientific Discovery via Active Experimentation with LLMs
works.strongest_capability: 57 enzyme-kinetics tasks with budgeted active assays and symbolic mechanism recovery
works.chemworld_boundary: stronger mechanism-recovery evaluation; ChemWorld adds multi-operation stateful experiment construction and shared physical resources

works.title: CausaLab: A Scalable Environment for Interactive Causal Discovery Toward AI Scientists
works.strongest_capability: random structural causal models with separate task prediction and graph-equation recovery
works.chemworld_boundary: preempts prediction-versus-understanding novelty; ChemWorld studies action-grounded chemical behavior rather than abstract SCM recovery

works.title: ReplaySCM: A Benchmark for Executable Causal Mechanism Induction from Interventions
works.strongest_capability: 1,300 Boolean SCM worlds with executable DSL replay on held-out interventions
works.chemworld_boundary: preempts executable-mechanism-replay novelty; ChemWorld replays physical state transitions and agent consequences

works.title: AI scientists produce results without reasoning scientifically
works.strongest_capability: more than 25,000 runs across eight environments with model-scaffold variance decomposition and epistemic trace analysis
works.chemworld_boundary: closest conceptual evidence; ChemWorld adds chemistry-grounded actions, randomized prior conditions, physical consequences and within-world fresh trajectories

works.title: EurekAgent: Agent Environment Engineering is All You Need For Autonomous Scientific Discovery
works.strongest_capability: explicit permissions, artifact, budget and human-interface engineering for bounded metric-driven discovery, with strong results in mathematics, kernel engineering and machine learning
works.chemworld_boundary: preempts environment engineering as a general framing; ChemWorld contributes a stateful physical chemistry substrate used as a controlled behavioral apparatus

works.title: AI agent behavioral science
works.strongest_capability: cross-setting synthesis of systematic behavioral observation, interventions and theory-guided interpretation for situated AI agents
works.chemworld_boundary: preempts the general behavioral-science framing; ChemWorld contributes a domain-specific executable apparatus and empirical chemistry-agent interventions

works.title: Socratic agents for autonomous scientific discovery in high-dimensional physical systems
works.strongest_capability: real optical closed-loop discovery with hypothesis generation, Socratic causal criticism, adaptive measurement, failure diagnosis and component ablation
works.chemworld_boundary: stronger real-platform epistemic autonomy and hypothesis discovery; ChemWorld adds chemistry-grounded identity control, resource receipts and fresh-trajectory phenotyping

works.title: End-to-end autonomous scientific discovery on a real optical platform
works.strongest_capability: nonlinear long-horizon research with Meta-Trace memory on a real optical platform, culminating in experimental validation of a reported previously unreported physical mechanism
works.chemworld_boundary: preempts first end-to-end, long-horizon or mechanism-discovery claims; ChemWorld contributes controlled repeatability and interventions on chemistry-grounded experimental behavior

works.title: LabUtopia: High-Fidelity Simulation and Hierarchical Benchmark for Scientific Embodied Agents
works.strongest_capability: multi-physics embodied laboratory simulation with 30 tasks and more than 200 scene and instrument assets
works.chemworld_boundary: stronger perception and manipulation; ChemWorld abstracts motion to scale controlled experiments on evidence use

works.title: Labimus: A Simulation and Benchmark for Humanoid Dexterous Manipulation in Chemical Laboratory
works.strongest_capability: more than thirty functionally faithful organic-laboratory assets, particle powder physics, closed-loop readouts and precision-aware evaluation of dexterous procedures
works.chemworld_boundary: stronger dexterity, perception and precision evaluation; ChemWorld abstracts manipulation and measures evidence-conditioned experimental strategy

works.title: The ADePT framework for assessing autonomous laboratory robotics
works.strongest_capability: four-dimensional robotics assessment framing covering adaptability and learning, dexterity, perception and task complexity
works.chemworld_boundary: clarifies dimensions ChemWorld intentionally abstracts; it is a perspective framework rather than an empirical behavioral benchmark

works.title: MATTERIX: toward a digital twin for robotics-assisted chemistry laboratory automation
works.strongest_capability: multiscale robotic, fluid, powder, device, heat-transfer and kinetics simulation with sim-to-real workflow transfer
works.chemworld_boundary: stronger digital-twin fidelity; ChemWorld is a behavioral measurement apparatus rather than a robotics twin

works.title: LabOSBench: Benchmarking Computer Use Agents for Scientific Instrument Control
works.strongest_capability: 96 subtasks across eight scientific-instrument GUI simulators
works.chemworld_boundary: stronger GUI control; ChemWorld measures why and when an instrument is selected and how evidence changes subsequent experiments

works.title: LabRobFail: A Benchmark for Robotic Failure Analysis in Chemical Self-driving Laboratory
works.strongest_capability: more than 20,000 failure-injected trajectories over more than 70 scenarios with fine-grained diagnosis and correction
works.chemworld_boundary: stronger failure taxonomy and perception; ChemWorld retains failures as consequences inside an experimental-learning trajectory

works.title: ScienceBoard: Evaluating Multimodal Autonomous Agents in Realistic Scientific Workflows
works.strongest_capability: 169 human-validated tasks across six domains in dynamic professional-software environments with GUI and CLI interaction
works.chemworld_boundary: stronger software, visual and multi-domain workflow realism; ChemWorld evaluates evidence-producing actions in a hidden chemical process rather than completion of a specified digital workflow

works.title: Benchmarking AI Agents for Addressing Scientific Challenges Across Scales
works.strongest_capability: approximately 200 real scientific scenarios with stepwise verification in an interactive agent-agnostic environment
works.chemworld_boundary: stronger multi-domain task authenticity and stepwise workflow evaluation; ChemWorld adds an identity-controlled chemical causal substrate, physical resource consequences and paired information interventions

works.title: ChemReason-Bench: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Procedural Reasoning in Experimental Chemistry
works.strongest_capability: 7,306 human-validated procedural-reasoning tasks from 500 reactions across six verifiable formats, with multi-model and adaptation comparisons
works.chemworld_boundary: stronger static procedure reasoning scale and validation; ChemWorld lets an agent create the procedure through state-changing experiments and bear physical and resource consequences

works.title: LLEMA: Evolutionary Search with LLMs for Multi-Objective Materials Discovery
works.strongest_capability: LLM-guided, chemistry-constrained evolutionary search with memory and surrogate oracles across fourteen multi-objective materials tasks
works.chemworld_boundary: stronger multi-objective candidate generation, algorithm comparison and materials breadth; ChemWorld's action unit is a stateful experiment lifecycle rather than a candidate-oracle query

works.title: Hierarchical Experimentalist Agents
works.strongest_capability: active intervention, hypothesis testing, composable skill learning and cross-level transfer in a procedural-physics tool-calling environment
works.chemworld_boundary: preempts active experimentation and reusable experimental learning as absolute novelties; ChemWorld adds chemistry-native sample lifecycles, characterization, entity resources and fixed-world prior-intervention replication

works.title: AgentChemist: A Multi-Agent Experimental Robotic Platform Integrating Chemical Perception and Precise Control
works.strongest_capability: real-time chemical perception and feedback-driven robotic control demonstrated by autonomous acid-base titration
works.chemworld_boundary: stronger visual perception, precision control and physical execution; ChemWorld contributes controlled behavioral intervention and repeatability rather than robot capability

chemworld_current_limitations: formal agent results exist for two of fifteen registered tasks
G2 replication covers one task, two selected worlds and one model configuration
instrument packets are synthetic state-coupled signals rather than empirical spectrum predictors
no visual manipulation, real instrument, wet-lab or sim-to-real evidence
current task and world transformations are bounded rather than unlimited
native provider sampling seeds are unavailable
trajectory metrics are operational definitions and require complete-trace reporting
